title: decision-gate.sh block + danger 统一检查
acceptance_criteria: L1 存在性: scripts/permission/decision-gate.sh 存在 + 可执行 + tests/integration/3-modes/decision-gate-test.sh 存在

L2 实质性: decision-gate.sh 真实支持 5 block (block.ambiguous_options / block.performer_failure / block.rule_exception / block.epic_critical / block.high_impact) + 3 danger (danger.miao_modify / danger.security_failing / danger.data_destruction), 命中即 exit 2 写 .kallax/inbox/decision-<ACTION>-<TS>.md + 写 .kallax/audit/decision-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl 审计, 非 block/danger action 0 退出
L3 接线正确: jq 读 .mode 兼容, JSONL 格式合法, ask file markdown 模板含 Approve/Reject/Defer 3 选项
L4 数据流动: decision-gate-test.sh 跑 PASS, 覆盖 ai-auto + danger.delete_data 场景
